````{yaml}
I would like to build a Quarto dashboard, powered by 
R, that has 3 primary functions. #1 - user types an 
address, #2 - a map displays the address, and #3 -data 
is shown about the address. I do have a US Census 
API Key if we go that route for the address data, but 
I am open to alternatives. Please provide all code 
necessary to execute this dashboard 
````

:::

## &emsp;&emsp;&emsp;&emsp;AI Categorization^[full report available [here](https://github.com/jtkulas/LiveStreams/blob/main/slides/2026/7_21_26/AI.pdf)]

<br>

::: {.Smallest}

| Level | Reasoning Depth | Context Awareness | Speed | R/Quarto Support | Best For | Cost/Privacy |
|-------|-----------------|-------------------|-------|------------------|----------|--------------|
| 1. Standalone | High | Project description | Medium | Excellent (via prompting) | Planning & learning | Varies (API) |
| 2. IDE-Integrated | Medium | File + open project | High | Strong (esp. Copilot) | Daily coding | Subscription |
| 3. Agentic | High | Full codebase | Medium-High | Good (with good prompting) | Complex/multi-file work | Higher |
| 4. Platform | Medium | Repo + team | Medium | Good | Review & collab | Platform-dependent |

:::

![](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2lydXNidDdybDVtMWpyMTB2MWowdXBtZTlkangwY2VmNndld3JneCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/llwf790LJlOThd1Q3g/giphy.gif){.absolute left="0" top="-40" height="230" .mirror}
